updates.name: Brent M. Lofgren
updates.bio: Physical scientist at NOAA's Great Lakes Environmental Research Laboratory since 1996, per a GLERL-hosted CV dated December 2015, with a Princeton PhD in atmospheric and oceanic sciences. Research covers atmospheric models coupled to land and water surfaces, Great Lakes regional climate and hydrology across years to decades, East African land use and climate, and communicating climate change.
updates.research_interests: regional atmospheric modeling coupled to land and lake surfaces; interannual to interdecadal climate of the Laurentian Great Lakes basin; regional climate modeling and its interaction with hydrology; land use and climate interactions in East Africa; climate change communication
updates.current_affiliation: NOAA Great Lakes Environmental Research Laboratory
updates.evidence: Physical Scientist, NOAA Great Lakes Environmental Research Laboratory, Ann Arbor, MI, June 1996- present.
updates.notes: GLERL people page (www.glerl.noaa.gov/people/) and profiles/lofgren.html return 404; the GLERL-hosted 2-page CV (file named Dec15) is the only page about this person found, so title is as of that CV and status left null. Existing ORCID 0000-0003-2189-0914 checked at pub.orcid.org: name Brent Lofgren; employment Great Lakes Environmental Research Laboratory, Physical Scientist, Meteorology, from 1996-06-16, no end date (consistent). No Google Scholar link found on a fetched page. VERIFIER 2026-10-26: CV re-fetched (200) and ORCID person/employments re-fetched; bio and evidence confirmed; research-interests item 'climate change impacts on Great Lakes hydrology' replaced by the CV's 'regional climate modeling and interaction with hydrology'.

updates.name: Jon Mitchell
updates.bio: Stewardship Coordinator at the Narragansett Bay National Estuarine Research Reserve and the listed contact for its Wood Steward Program. The reserve's stewardship program manages grassland, salt marsh and pine barren habitats through cutting, prescribed burns, invasive plant removal and monitoring of marsh change.
updates.current_affiliation: Narragansett Bay National Estuarine Research Reserve (RI DEM)
